preconditions.description: The dimensions of the table must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in table)
preconditions.description: Each row of the table must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'DIMAI' for row in table for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the table must be one of 'D', 'I', 'M', 'A', or 'I'.

postconditions.description: If Inna cannot go through the name DIMA at least once, output 'Poor Dima!'.
If Inna can go through the name DIMA an infinite number of times, output 'Poor Inna!'.
If Inna can go through the name DIMA a finite number of times, output the maximum number of times as a non-negative integer.
